elevation_model.basis: OSM layer ordinal x 6 m. Ramped: a grade-separated edge meets the grade of the road it joins over 120 m; ground roads unchanged; junction lanes interpolate between the roads they connect.

axes.source: SUMO metres, x east, y north
axes.scene: Three.js metres, x east, y up, z south
axes.heading: rotation_y = -radians(sumo_angle); mesh forward is -Z

transform.elevation_basis: The SUMO network carries no z values; every lane shape is 2D. Elevation is reconstructed from the OSM 'layer' ordinal at 6.0 m per layer step. This orders grade-separated structures correctly but is not a measurement of any real height.

rows.note: Every frame of the ambulance, not a sample: its scene position, heading and lane must be the transform of SUMO's own record at that timestamp.
